title: Insight Engine user preferences
description: User-level, cross-session preferences for the Insight Engine. Lives OUTSIDE the plugin (default ~/.insight-engine/preferences.json) so it survives plugin upgrades and is never version-controlled. Currently carries only the adjudication standing opt-out; add future keys under new top-level properties.

schema_version.description: Bump only with a documented migration in prefs.py.

standing_opt_out.description: Whether, and at what scope, the operator has permanently declined the Step 10 adjudication offer. Honoured on every future qualifying run until re-enabled.

scope.description: none = offer normally (default). crosslab = suppress ONLY the cross-lab rung A offer; still offer the in-boundary rungs (B Fable / C Opus panel). all = suppress the entire adjudication offer.

set_on.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the current scope was set; null when scope is none.

note.description: Optional free-text reason recorded by the operator; never surfaced in any deliverable.
